sources.fullCitation: “Léo Lelièvre fils.” Portrait photograph by Henri Manuel. L’Ami du peuple (Paris), 12 May 1929, p. 9. Digitised press collection of the Bibliothèque nationale de France. Accessed 25 August 2026.
sources.title: Léo Lelièvre fils
sources.creator: Henri Manuel (photographer)
sources.researchNote: The studio credit “(Photo Henri Manuel)” is printed beneath the image. The page was retrieved under the distinguishing form “Léo Lelièvre fils”, which separates the sitter from his father, the chansonnier Léo Lelièvre (1872-1956); in 1929, the year of the portrait, the son was thirty and had been writing for the Casino de Paris beside Henri Varna.

media.title: Léo Lelièvre fils — portrait photograph by Henri Manuel, 1929
media.description: Press portrait of the lyricist Léo Lelièvre fils, printed in the Paris daily L’Ami du peuple on 12 May 1929 with the studio credit “(Photo Henri Manuel)”.
media.altText: Half-length newspaper portrait of Léo Lelièvre fils, turned in profile.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The portrait carries the studio credit of Henri Manuel, who died in 1947, so the seventy-year term of protection in France ran out at the end of 2017; the issue in which it appeared was published in 1929.
media.publicCaption: Portrait of the lyricist Léo Lelièvre fils, published in L’Ami du peuple on 12 May 1929.
